description: Sends a question to a CANOPY sales manager, who replies by email within one business day: for anything the other tools don't answer, such as a specific price, a move-in date or a custom space. Step 1, without confirm_token: returns a preview and a confirm_token (valid 10 minutes); nothing is saved. Step 2, with the same details and the confirm_token: sends the question. Only call step 2 after the person agrees.
name: ask_sales_question
title: Ask CANOPY's sales team a question (two steps)
